description: Kolesarske poti v občini Tržič is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by OBČINA TRŽIČ. Cycling trails on Tržič. Coverage: OBČINA TRŽIČ. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling routes in the municipality of Tržič" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is OBČINA TRŽIČ. Its keywords include kolesarska pot, kolesarjenje, kolesarske poti, kolesarske steze. The listing shows 2 download or service links in ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
